conditions: Preserve 144*O useful PWP bytes per center, but freeze a 32-byte-aligned physical stride and charge every padding byte. This changes q128/O1 from a 144-byte physical stride to 160 bytes.

Generalize the q32-only matcher and one-word bitmap accounting before execution: serial16 extra passes, pattern/config beats, bitmap seal words, q-specific runs and 8/O tile replays must all be explicit.
decision.fallback_if_alignment_repair_is_rejected: Run only q16/O8, q32/O4 and q64/O2; q128/O1 is NO_GO on the frozen 32-byte DMA without padding.
decision.why_worth_doing: All four points use nested train-only H67 catalogs, exact fallback, the same eight-output workload, SHARED96 port, serial16 matcher family, descriptor SRAM and two 32-KiB tile slots. The fixed product makes worst-case useful PWP bytes per tile constant while exposing the real trade between matcher passes, q-specific reconstruction work and 8/O replay overhead. M394 already establishes a valid H67 q32/O4 anchor, so this is a bounded performance DSE rather than a new speculative subsystem.

identity.catalog_population: M73 disjoint DSEC train-only S32 over 18 sequences

m358_legacy_structural_result.permitted_role: structural recurrence and capacity cross-check only; its PAFT runtime performance numbers are forbidden

m384_q32_o4_rtl.permitted_role: q32/O4 boundary reference only; not evidence for other q/O points

frozen_minimum_execution_contract.name: M396_H67_EP35_FIXED_PRODUCT_QO_DSE_R1
population_and_catalog: Rebuild all 17,280 phases from the exact-SHA M40 H67 ep35/no-running payload already frozen through M394.
For each q, use exactly the first q centers of the nested M338 train-only catalog; nearest Hamming distance with lowest center ID tie-break.
Never substitute PAFT ep4 runtime counts, M358 cycle totals or a catalog fitted on validation/test rows.

exact_selection.fallback: all zero rows are elided; every nonzero row not satisfying strict use_pwp is reconstructed by exact bit-sparse fallback
exact_selection.pwp_reconstruction: original == (center OR plus_mask) AND NOT minus_mask, plus=original AND NOT center, minus=center AND NOT original

matcher_and_config.bitmap_seal_cycles: ceil(q/32), using a fixed 32-bit seal interface; active_count is carried with the first word
matcher_and_config.descriptor_write_behavior: one active descriptor per accepted matched row at II1; descriptor SRAM remains 48 bits with a fixed 7-bit center field for every q
matcher_and_config.no_free_work: additional serial16 passes, config beats and bitmap words may not overlap matcher or tile0 DMA without separately proven timestamps

tile_layout_and_dma.padding_policy: padding bytes are reserved in the 32-KiB slot and transferred for every selected center; no useful-work credit is assigned to padding
tile_layout_and_dma.used_center_commands_per_tile: one command per maximal consecutive run in the q-specific direct-address used-center bitmap
tile_layout_and_dma.tile_commands: one weight command plus used_center_runs(q) PWP commands
tile_layout_and_dma.tile_addresses: weight base and every direct PWP center base must be 32-byte aligned; run bytes equal run_length*physical_stride
tile_layout_and_dma.slot_capacity: pattern config reservation + weight bytes + q*physical PWP stride must be <=32768 for each of the two ping-pong slots

replay_recurrence.why_pwp_has_two: SHARED96 serializes the PWP base-vector source with signed correction work; no WIDE144 credit
replay_recurrence.descriptor_transactions: active_rows are requested, returned and accepted once per output tile, so each count is active_rows*(8/O)
replay_recurrence.empty_phase_cycles: config_dma + matcher + bitmap_seal + 2; no weight/PWP tile load or descriptor replay
replay_recurrence.overlap: only tile t+1 DMA may overlap tile t replay in the alternate slot; first tile DMA and final replay are exposed; no cross-phase overlap
replay_recurrence.commit_cycles: 96,000 per sample outside the phase recurrence

fair_bit_sparse_baseline.identity: the unchanged M394 H67 bit-sparse SHARED96 comparator over all eight output blocks
fair_bit_sparse_baseline.overlap: current compute may overlap only the next baseline preprocess, exactly as in M394
fair_bit_sparse_baseline.forbidden_weakening: Do not tile or serialize the baseline by 8/O, do not charge candidate-only catalog work to it, and do not change its port or frequency between DSE points.

mandatory_outputs: q-specific population, pwp/fallback/correction work, used-center counts and maximal-run counts
per-point config, matcher, seal, tile0 DMA, exposed later-tile DMA, replay, tail and commit cycle components
per-point useful bytes, physical padding bytes, command counts and worst-case slot footprint
descriptor write/request/response/bundle counts and D8 occupancy assumptions
exact reproduction of the M394 q32/O4 cmd32/L8 point before any ranking
one unchanged baseline total repeated identically for all four rows
SHA-frozen CSV/JSON and a double-sealed result directory
negative_controls: Use 144 bytes as the q128/O1 physical stride and require the alignment gate to fail.
Drop one q128 serial16 extra pass and require the matcher ledger to fail.
Set tile_count=O rather than 8/O and require replay/weight conservation to fail.
Treat all selected centers as one command when their IDs are nonconsecutive and require run accounting to fail.
Substitute WIDE144 or SYSTOLIC_Q cycles and require the resource-identity gate to fail.
Disable fallback for any nonzero non-PWP row and require exact reconstruction/population conservation to fail.

why_wide_or_systolic_numbers_are_forbidd.WIDE144_PWP_96_WEIGHT: It adds an independent 144-bit PWP datapath beside the 96-bit weight path and changes each PWP row from two SHARED96 source cycles to one. That is a resource expansion, not a q/O point on the requested common port.
why_wide_or_systolic_numbers_are_forbidd.SYSTOLIC_Q_II1: It replaces serial16's eligible-row extra passes with an all-q II1 search and q-cycle fill. M376 also shows the fully parallel q128 matcher is a materially different area point; its performance cannot be borrowed without equal-area/equal-frequency normalization.
why_wide_or_systolic_numbers_are_forbidd.legacy_population: M358 used PAFT ep4/running-BN M248 runtime and a different baseline total. Only its 8/O ping-pong recurrence and capacity algebra may inform M396; none of its performance numbers may be copied into H67 ep35/no-running results.
why_wide_or_systolic_numbers_are_forbidd.missing_current_overheads: The older endpoints do not establish the M396 cmd32/L8, q-wide bitmap seal, q128 32-byte padding and current H67 maximal-run command ledger under one frozen model.

findings.title: q128/O1's requested 144-byte direct slot is not legal on the 32-byte DMA
findings.detail: 144 mod 32 is 16. A direct center address base+center*144 alternates between aligned and half-beat addresses, and every odd-length maximal run has a half-beat byte count. Free rounding would undercharge traffic and break direct addressing. Freeze a 160-byte physical stride and charge 16 padding bytes per selected center, or remove q128/O1. The padded worst-case slot is still only 22,272 bytes.

findings.title: M394's q32-only recurrence cannot be parameter-substituted
findings.detail: M394 hard-codes 3000+eligible+2 matcher cycles, a 32-bit bitmap, one seal cycle, 576-byte PWP slots and exactly two replays. Fair q16/q64/q128 rows require the serial16 multiplier ceil(q/16)-1, ceil(q/32) bitmap words, q-specific pattern beats/runs/stride and tile_count=8/O. Any analyzer that changes only q and O while retaining the q32 control constants is NO_GO.

findings.title: Fixed q*O equalizes useful PWP capacity, not implementation area
findings.detail: Every unpadded full tile carries 18,432 useful PWP bytes, but q changes center storage, matcher passes and bitmap/run logic while O changes replay count. A cycle-DSE winner still needs logic-only DC and eventually physical memory normalization before an area-efficiency claim.

findings.title: The current M384 controller is fixed to q32/O4
findings.detail: M384 exposes 512 center bits, a 32-bit bitmap, five-bit run start, 576-byte PWP stride and exactly replay0/replay1. It is valid only as the q32/O4 boundary anchor. M396 can rank simulator points, but q16/q64/q128 are not current-RTL-backed.

findings.title: Serial16 is a family-level resource identity, not yet a four-point DC proof
findings.detail: The contract reuses one 16-center search bank across passes, but config depth and q-wide control still vary. No exact-SHA four-point synthesis, equal-frequency check or area-normalized throughput exists yet.

findings.title: The fair baseline remains cycle-simulator evidence
findings.detail: The frozen 742,148,386-cycle comparator is a valid common H67 simulator oracle, but there is no matched baseline RTL or physical SRAM/DRAM implementation. A successful DSE remains a standalone four-bottleneck-Conv module estimate.

findings.title: No performance conclusion exists before q-specific H67 execution
findings.detail: This prereview proves that the repaired experiment is bounded, fits and can be fair. It does not compute q-specific H67 work/cycles, select a winner, admit speedup, energy, PPA, full-network performance or a DATE headline.
